registry.law: No route-born predicate semantics are currently independently authorized. Empty is complete, not missing, for this registry version.

argument_states.ARGUMENTS_VALID: All required exact arguments resolve under the registered schema with matching IDs/hashes and lawful epistemic/use state.
argument_states.ARGUMENT_UNKNOWN: A declared argument is semantically unknown/unresolved under its producer authority; evaluator does not coerce it to false/zero.
argument_states.ARGUMENT_NOT_APPLICABLE: Registered predicate schema explicitly makes the argument/domain inapplicable for this route; only lawful where the predicate defines this state.
argument_states.ARGUMENT_MISSING: A required declared argument/reference is absent or cannot resolve; no predicate truth value is fabricated.
argument_states.ARGUMENT_FORBIDDEN: Argument source belongs to actor/V556/V2 or otherwise exceeds ADP-003 jurisdiction.

result_states.PREDICATE_TRUE: Registered predicate evaluates positively from complete lawful arguments.
result_states.PREDICATE_FALSE: Registered predicate evaluates negatively from complete lawful arguments.
result_states.PREDICATE_UNKNOWN: Registered predicate semantics permit evaluation but lawful input state is unknown/noncomparable/unresolved; no false coercion.
result_states.PREDICATE_NOT_APPLICABLE: Registered predicate explicitly does not apply to the exact route under its own governed domain rule.
result_states.VALID_EMPTY_NO_ROUTE_BORN_PREDICATES: No registered route-born predicates apply because registry is valid-empty; route may still exist under ADP-002 and retains inherited V554 F2 refs.
result_states.MISSING_PREDICATE_AUTHORITY: Requested predicate ID/version is not registered or owning semantic authority is absent.
result_states.DEFERRED_MISSING_ARGUMENT: Registered predicate exists but a required argument is missing/unresolved where truth cannot be computed.
result_states.DENIED_FOREIGN_JURISDICTION: Evaluation attempt depends on V554-owned duplicated meaning, actor state/history, V556 relation/topology, V2/session, or other forbidden input.
result_states.INTEGRITY_FAILURE: Predicate/route/rule/argument/receipt identity or hash fails verification.

v554_f2_nonduplication.law: Every V554 STRUCTURAL_MEDIATION_APPLICABILITY_CONDITION remains producer-owned and crosses V555 only by exact reference. ADP-003 never copies its predicate ID, semantic content, evaluator, result, or runtime-binding meaning into a V555 route-born predicate.
v554_f2_nonduplication.before_route_test: If the condition has the same semantic meaning before the V555 route is created, it is not route-born.
v554_f2_nonduplication.rename_test: Renaming/rewording/specializing an inherited F2 without new route-created semantic content remains duplication and is forbidden.
v554_f2_nonduplication.evaluation_separation: A V554 F2 result is produced by its V554-authorized evaluator/owner. ADP-003 receipts may reference that condition/result as provenance only when a future registered route-born predicate lawfully requires the producer result without re-owning it; v1 registers none.
v554_f2_nonduplication.deferred_runtime_position: Inherited V554 runtime-position/genealogy requirements remain inherited exact refs and are not asserted satisfied or converted to V555 predicates.

replay_provenance.same_input_rule: Same exact route/predicate/argument/authority identities and versions produce the same result and receipt hash.

GOVERNING_SPIRIT_CHECK.ambiguity: Architecture requires a route-condition family, while accepted/current evidence authorizes no concrete route-born predicate semantics.
GOVERNING_SPIRIT_CHECK.choice: Bind the minimum sufficient registry/evaluator/receipt contract and keep predicate entries valid-empty until exact independently accepted route-born semantic authority exists.
principles: downstream vividness does not exceed upstream authority
